title: Agent
description: Rootless shape facet — PROV Agent: "something that bears some form of responsibility for an activity taking place, for the existence of an entity, or for another agent's activity". An agent has an identifier and an optional set of attribute-value pairs; PROV does not prescribe the identification scheme. Source: W3C PROV-DM (REC-prov-dm-20130430) §5.3.1 Agent, agent(id, [attr1=val1, ...]); PROV-O prov:Agent.

id.description: Identifier for the agent — mandatory per PROV-DM §5.7.1; a qualified name, mappable to an IRI (§5.7.5).
